profile.research_note: [batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This is the Oregon State Data Center in Salem, the state capital, operated by Enterprise Information Services, the state central IT agency, under its Data Center Services program, providing centralized data center hosting for Oregon state agencies. This facility is unrelated to a separate, much larger private data center campus proposed for the Salem area by a company called Verrus, a 5.1 billion dollar commercial project for which Oregon's governor directed the withdrawal of state owned land in 2026 amid public opposition; that project is a distinct commercial entity and should not be conflated with this state government facility. No detailed capacity or megawattage figures for this facility were published on the state's own site as of this research. This research was carried out at the operator level in an earlier phase of this project.
